content:
Fernando discussed his Pokémon 3D Mod on Mac, while Jeff shared his experience running a native port of Mario Kart 64 on iPhone. The two hosts also discussed why tech products don't feel as exciting as they used to, and shared their thoughts on using the same device for many years.

9to5Mac Overtime is a video-focused weekly podcast that explores interesting discoveries and observations within the Apple ecosystem, hosted by 9to5Mac's Fernando Silva and Jeff Benjamin. Subscribe to Overtime on Apple Podcasts and our YouTube channel for more content.
